IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Thursday, September 24, 2026**

**LU-494 Milwaukee, WI** is running hot. Sixty-seven calls, only 330 hands on the board—that's a 5-to-1 ratio screaming for bodies. Gurtz Electric and Cupertino Electric are both reposting thirty-slot calls at the Port Washington Data Center, and they're offering **JW wage plus $10/hr** to stick around. Wisconsin license required, but if you've got it, that's a straight premium on top. Data center work is typically steady nine-to-five; this gig's been reposted twice, which means retention's the real problem.

**LU-613 Atlanta, GA** sits on 104 calls but only 785 hands—nearly a 7-to-1 board. Miller Electrical Contractors is running two separate 79-hand calls on the QTS Fayetteville data center, conduit and cable tray at **$42/hr**. Inglett & Stubbs mirrors the project with 53-hand calls on the same site, same rate, working 4-10s and 2-8s under General Foreman Tommy Jett. All calls list rates—that's rare—so the board's transparent on pay.

**LU-583 El Paso, TX** is fat with specialty work. Twenty-five calls, only 48 hands—you're walking on. B & D Industries' Project Miner in Santa Teresa, NM, is the standout: six Inside JW slots at **$70/hr** with all OT double time after 40 hours. That's a legitimate spec premium. Coltrane's Meta El Paso job pays **$45/hr** plus **$100/day per diem**, all requiring state license and clean drug screens.

**LU-602 Amarillo, TX** features Rosendin Electric's Claude, TX build at **$52.30/hr**, 60/60/50 OT structure with **$40/day zone pay**, plus NFPA 70E certification. Forty-four hands across multiple calls. Michels Power's lineman work in Midland pays **$60.59/hr**—the highest single call on the board—but that's transmission, not inside.

**LU-354 Salt Lake City, UT** has META and QTS data center work stacked at **$46.22/hr** with **$225 incentive** per ten-hour day. Book depth looks manageable at 130 hands for 28 calls.

**LU-1547 Anchorage, AK** is the outlier: 23 calls, 29 hands. Northern Powerline's underground feeder rebuild pays **$76.90/hr**—highest single call in this briefing—but it's lineman work, three positions, Alaskan pay for Alaskan cost of living.

**The trend:** Data centers are hoovering labor coast-to-coast. Scale's flat, but zone pay and per-diem are where margins hide.

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Thursday, September 24, 2026**

**LU-84 Newnan, GA** is running hot with 28 calls and 122 hands needed across Georgia. SERVICE ELECTRIC's Social Circle Energize Job is the standout: **$56.80/hr** for Journeyman Lineman with Quanta barehand cert (that's **$10/hr over scale**), **$150/day** per diem, working 5-10s. HEART UTILITIES has 20 JL slots in Savannah at **$46.80/hr**, and FAITH ELECTRIC LLC is anchoring the board with 10 JL positions in College Park/Columbus at **$49.80/hr** (**$3 above JL scale**) plus hotels provided.

**LU-602 Amarillo, TX** is the transmission play. MICHELS POWER is calling 10 Journeyman Lineman to Midland at **$60.59/hr** — highest rate on the board — doing transmission work 6-12s with **$175/day** per diem. ROSENDIN ELECTRIC has 12 Inside JW in Claude at **$52.30/hr** running 60/60/50 OT=DT with 40/day zone pay. This is serious money on a lean 7-call board.

**LU-1393 Indianapolis, IN** stacks 16 calls across four contractors with solid JL transmission work. Ampjack America is running 345kv tower raises in Valpo/New Carlisle at **$67.18/hr** (**$200/day** per diem) requiring steel climbing. P&G Power's Goshen job hits the same rate on 69kv pole sets and wire pull. MJ Electric and Kent Power slot in at **$56.66/hr** on lattice tower and substation work — books are shallow, book 1 moving fast.

**LU-474 Memphis, TN** is data-center heavy with 6 calls but 96 hands needed. Copperhead and Cache Valley are both offering **$48.25/hr** Inside JW work (Copperhead's **$10 over scale**, night shift, rolling 4 on 1 off). ArchKey and Gephart undercut at **$38.25/hr**, but that volume is real.

**LU-1547 Anchorage, AK** has 24 calls on a 30-hand board — almost all overhead. The work is mixed (tree service, telecom, remediation), wages range **$24.18–$64.74/hr** depending on the gig, and nothing's stacked deep, but mobility is there.

Data centers and transmission rebuilds are swallowing linemen nationwide — 987 hands across 325 calls means work is there, but boards are shallow and specialty certs (barehand, Secret clearance, nuclear) are gatekeeping premium rates.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Thursday, September 24, 2026**

**LU-213 St. John, NB** is running heavy with 8 calls and 31 hands on the board. Irving Oil Refinery is the anchor—CAM's got 9 journeyman pipefitters on day shift under GPMA Agreement, plus 7 F3/F4 welder slots (testing required), and two separate apprentice instrument tech calls (6 and 4 hands) rotating days and nights. This is refinery work with real staying power. The entire board is Irving-locked, which means consistency but zero optionality if that contract shifts.

**LU-208 Denver, CO** sits at 8 calls, 29 hands. US Eng. Metalworks is hunting 3 fitters with stainless experience and 4 SS TIG welders out of their shop. Apollo's pushing 7 fitters into DC2 Data Center in Aurora on 6/10s days at commercial rate plus incentive (specifics TBD at dispatch). US Eng. Construction needs high-purity fitters with tube bending chops for Broadcom in Fort Collins—that's semiconductor-adjacent work, finicky specs. Trautman and Shreve's got 3 combo welder slots (MIG/TIG), 1 day and 2 swing. Specialty skill stacks rule this board.

**LU-776 Lima, OH** has 5 calls, 45 hands. Gem's fab shop is testing combo welders (bennies don't stack). Graham's got 8 pipefitters into Cenovus Maintenance running 6-10s with spotty OT starting 6am. BDO Fab Shop is moving 8 more pipefitters into 7-10s (apprenticeship pathway available). Upland Mechanical's Lima Data Center play is sweet—8 pipefitters, all OT paid at double time, scheduled 5-1. That's the standout: OT at full premium is rare.

**LU-325 Fredericton, NB** shows 1 call, 1 hand. Pivot's placing a journeyman pipefitter at Job #6033 (Pepsi Moncton Site) on 5-10s with possible overtime. Thin board but clean work.

Data center builds and refinery maintenance are pulling hands faster than fab shops can feed them.
